name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Cross-sector momentum/relative-value: long confirmed sector breakouts (biotech, financials, regional banks), short confirmed breakdowns (gold miners, long bonds) and crypto weakness, avoiding AI/semis entirely.
novelty: Round 1 and 2 were both concentrated long AI-infra/semis compute beta. Round 3 drops AI/tech exposure almost entirely and instead harvests cross-sector momentum/relative-value: long the strongest non-tech breakout sectors (biotech, financials, regional banks) against short positions in sectors showing confirmed technical breakdowns (gold miners, long bonds) plus a crypto-weakness short via perp. The edge is trend-confirmation pairs trading across uncorrelated sectors, not a single-theme directional bet.

positions.thesis: Biotech breaking out hard across all timeframes (+14.6% 1m, +82.7% 12m) as rate-cut hopes and M&A activity return; strongest momentum signal in the tape outside AI.
Financials leading market with +6% 1m on steepening curve expectations and resilient credit conditions; broad-based sector strength.
Regional banks confirming financials momentum (+5.5% 1m, +10.2% 3m) as funding-cost pressure eases; a relative-value complement to XLF within financials.
Healthcare showing renewed momentum (+4% 1m) after a weak 6-12mo stretch, defensive ballast that also participates in the same rotation as biotech.
Gold miners in a confirmed technical breakdown (-13.2% 1m, -24.3% 3m, -23.6% 6m) despite gold-adjacent yearly strength, reflecting margin compression and momentum exhaustion.
Long bonds stuck in a persistent downtrend (-1.4/-1.9/-2.5% across 1-6mo) as rate-cut timing keeps getting pushed out; carry-friendly short via borrow cost only 3% APR.
ETH in a severe multi-timeframe downtrend (-19.8% 3m, -43.2% 6m, -44.1% 12m) with no reversal signal; tactical short avoids longs-only funding drag.

outlook: Rotation broadening beyond mega-cap tech: biotech (XBI) and financials (XLF/KRE) show accelerating multi-month momentum while gold miners (GDX) and long bonds (TLT) are in confirmed downtrends (GDX -13%/1m, -24%/3m) as real rates stay firm. Crypto remains in a broad downtrend (BTC -46%/12m, ETH -44%/12m) with no reversal signal yet, favoring a tactical short. Keeping cash buffer for weekly reassessment given the sector-rotation regime is only weeks old.
